mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for optimizing a website for AI entities?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an audit to identify existing entities and content structure. This is followed by keyword and entity research to understand how your audience and AI perceive your industry. Next, schema markup is implemented to explicitly define entities and their relationships on your website. Content is then optimized to feature these entities naturally and consistently, ensuring semantic clarity. Ongoing monitoring and adjustments are crucial to maintain performance as AI algorithms evolve and your content grows.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves auditing current content, conducting entity research, implementing schema markup, optimizing content for entities, and continuous monitoring.
